progressSummary: Audited V3-08 requires repair; WIP baseline preserved when a safe delta existed.

openFindings.path: scripts/e2e-android.js (waitFor app-crash detection, lines ~352-372) and __tests__/domain/v3-08-finalizer-wrapper.test.ts (test 'waitFor detects app crash and relaunches instead of waiting full timeout', lines 160-170)
openFindings.problem: The new crash-detection feature cannot detect a crashed app: `adb shell pidof <package>` exits 1 with empty stdout when the app process is dead, execFileSync throws, the surrounding try/catch swallows the error, and the `if (!pid)` relaunch branch is unreachable. The feature claims to save up to 10 minutes of wasted wait time on app crash/ANR, but in the exact crash scenario it burns the full timeout with empty dumps — the failure mode it was written to fix. The guarding test is a weak static-string check (APP CRASHED/pidof/force-stop/monkey substrings) that passes even though the feature is non-functional.
openFindings.evidence: Simulation with a command exiting 1 with empty output (exact adb shell pidof semantics for a dead app) through the same execFileSync/retry/catch structure: 'relaunch triggered: false'. Android toybox pidof exits 1 when no process matches, so pidof never returns empty with exit 0; the catch comment 'pidof failed — proceed with normal wait' swallows the very signal that indicates a dead app. The same latent pattern exists in the pre-existing timeout diagnostic (lines 408-413), but there it only degrades a diagnostic, whereas here it disables the claimed repair.
openFindings.requiredFix: Distinguish pidof's 'no process' exit (err.status === 1) from adb transport failures and trigger the relaunch on status 1: e.g. capture the error, treat err.status === 1 as app-dead → invalidate dump cache, force-stop, monkey relaunch, sleep 15s, continue; treat other errors (transport) as 'proceed with normal wait'. Strengthen the wrapper test to verify the error-status handling (e.g. assert the code checks err.status or equivalent) instead of only static strings, so the feature cannot silently regress to dead code.
openFindings.verification: Re-run node --check scripts/e2e-android.js, npx jest __tests__/domain/v3-08-finalizer-wrapper.test.ts, and a behavior simulation where the pidof command exits 1 → the relaunch branch executes (APP CRASHED logged, monkey invoked).
